title: Synthesis and evaluation of coumarin derivatives as potential anticancer therapies for colon cancer: In vitro antiproliferation, cell cycle arrest analyses, network pharmacology investigations, and molecular docking studies.
authors: Zhao, Jianjun; Xing, Lin; Wang, Wan; Zhu, Kai; Sheng, Ruilong; Guo, Ruihua
one_liner_zh: 该文为香豆素衍生物的抗癌活性研究，涉及细胞实验与分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: In this study, a series of coumarin derivatives (1-25) were synthesized and characterized. The antiproliferative activities of these derivatives were systematically evaluated against two human cancer cell lines, HCT116 and SKOV3, using the CCK-8 viability assay. The results showed that derivatives 24 and 25 exhibited significant inhibitory activities against HCT116 cells (IC(50) = 8.48 +/- 0.92 muM) and (IC(50) = 8.95 +/- 0.67 muM), respectively, while derivative 25 also demonstrated good inhibitory activity against SKOV3 cells (IC(50) = 22.27 +/- 2.66 muM). Notably, when derivatives 24 and 25 were combined with paclitaxel, they significantly enhanced the S-phase cell cycle arrest. Subsequently, network pharmacology analysis of derivative 24 revealed that CTNNB1 was the most deeply colored target and exhibited the highest number of connections with other targets. Docking analysis indicated that derivative 24 could activate CTNNB1 by interacting with the GLN-302 and ARG-342 residues of the protein. Derivatives 24 and 25 are promising anticancer drug candidates derived from natural products.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，合成并表征了一系列香豆素衍生物（1-25）。利用CCK-8活力测定法，系统评估了这些衍生物对两种人癌细胞系HCT116和SKOV3的抗增殖活性。结果显示，衍生物24和25分别对HCT116细胞表现出显著的抑制活性（IC(50) = 8.48 ± 0.92 μM）和（IC(50) = 8.95 ± 0.67 μM），而衍生物25对SKOV3细胞也显示出良好的抑制活性（IC(50) = 22.27 ± 2.66 μM）。值得注意的是，当衍生物24和25与紫杉醇联合使用时，显著增强了S期细胞周期阻滞。随后，对衍生物24的网络药理学分析揭示，CTNNB1是最深色靶点，且与其他靶点的连接数最高。对接分析表明，衍生物24可通过与蛋白的GLN-302和ARG-342残基相互作用来激活CTNNB1。衍生物24和25是源自天然产物的有前景的抗癌药物候选物。
